about: The founder's targets for round 07 — what a good answer must get right, must never do, and what he would pick. Dictated in chat on 2026-09-23 after the discussion ("get me to say what i think a good answer would be, so you can continue iterating with a goal. cant let it be too rigid because to an extent we want the engineer to reason unbiased, not necessarily exactly as i would"). `said` is his text exactly as he sent it, typos kept — never reworded, never shown to the Engineer, never pasted into the prompt, KB or nets. `reading` is Claude's reading of it for grading, marked where unsure; he corrects it, it never outranks `said`. Grading: a try FAILS only on a must missed or a never done; a pick that differs from his, with a sound reason, is not wrong — it goes on his "it disagreed with you" list. Hold-outs (not tuned against; run only at the end of a loop): a-01, s-06, j-02. No target given: o-01, s-03, s-04, s-07 — general checks only (same advice both tries, nothing the driver said failed, numbers right).
